BiblicalUsage: Ziphron is a place on the northern boundary of the promised land, named once in the borders Moses lays out in Numbers. It sits in the line that runs from the wilderness to the sea, marking where the inheritance ends. The place has no story — only a boundary, and a promise on the inside of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God draws His boundaries carefully: the land had edges, and the promise had an address.
